nodes.name: Giveaway Backlog

nodes.name: Giveaway Page Template Requirements
nodes.summary: Hardened template with 14 required elements including canvas particles, aurora blobs, Cormorant Garamond, MastermindCTA, reactions section, email modal, and mobile design rules

nodes.name: Email Modal Trigger Pattern
nodes.summary: Two trigger patterns for GiveawayEmailModal: copy-prompt (on Copy button) and non-copy-prompt (auto-open after 20s, sessionStorage-suppressed)

nodes.name: Clone guardog, never benchmark
nodes.summary: Lesson from 2026-06-08: cloning benchmark propagated missing template elements; now must always clone guardog as structural baseline

nodes.name: Email modal required on every page
nodes.summary: Lesson from 2026-06-08: non-copy-prompt pages still need email capture; modal trigger depends on page type, never omit entirely

nodes.name: GiveawayAutoModal component
nodes.summary: Lesson from 2026-06-09: extracted auto-popup pattern into reusable component to reduce drift; preferred for non-copy-prompt pages

nodes.name: Three-edit registration rule
nodes.summary: Lesson from 2026-08-03: creating a giveaway requires page, registry entry, and delivery template; missing any leaves silent failures

nodes.name: Environment whitespace can break email delivery
nodes.summary: Lesson from 2026-08-03: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL trailing newline caused Resend 422 failures in production for 60+ days; now trim + strip CR/LF in getSiteUrl

nodes.name: GiveawayEmailModal
nodes.summary: Shared modal component for email collection across giveaway pages; submits to POST /api/lead-magnet with configurable headingOverride

nodes.name: GiveawayAutoModal
nodes.summary: Wrapper component encapsulating auto-popup state, timer, sessionStorage, and showCopiedBadge=false for non-copy-prompt pages

nodes.name: MastermindCTA
nodes.summary: Soft-sell block component with purple-pink gradient, 'Want to learn how to do this?' headline, and magnetic pink button

nodes.name: MastermindReactionsSection
nodes.summary: Testimonial carousel component required on every giveaway page; displays participant reactions and quotes

nodes.name: POST /api/lead-magnet
nodes.summary: Email capture and delivery endpoint; accepts {email, source, journeyId}, validates with regex, rate-limits (10 req/60s), persists to Supabase, sends via Resend

nodes.name: Giveaway Registry
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for giveaway metadata including slug, title, description, icon, badge type; used for routing and discovery

nodes.name: Phase 0: Pre-flight Checklist
nodes.summary: Four uniqueness checks before starting: slug directory, registry, ManyChat keyword, repo clean and on main

nodes.name: Phase 1: Technical Setup
nodes.summary: Create giveaway page from guardog template, register in giveaways.ts, commit, push, and deploy to production

nodes.name: Phase 2: Content
nodes.summary: Brief HookLab, generate hooks via CTA First mode, write full reel script, record video, add visuals and captions

nodes.name: Phase 3: Publishing
nodes.summary: Post to Instagram with structured caption, verify ManyChat automation is firing and active

nodes.name: giveaway-template-structure.test.ts
nodes.summary: Validates every giveaway page imports and wires GiveawayEmailModal or GiveawayAutoModal to one of two triggers

nodes.name: giveaway-email-collection.test.ts
nodes.summary: Asserts email collection contract: POSTs to /api/lead-magnet, client/server regex match, slug matches directory, validates + rate-limits + persists + delivers

nodes.name: Cost Stack Audit
nodes.summary: Calculator giveaway for identifying cost leaks; Joe-rated LOVED, rank 1, automation score 5, launched 2026-08-03, slug 'cost-stack', keyword 'STACK'

nodes.name: Bring the Task You Hate
nodes.summary: Free live workshop and hot-seat; five-day-sprint format; Joe-rated YES 2026-09-16, automation 2, live Sept 29, slug 'bring-the-task-you-hate'

nodes.name: Make AI Sound Like You
nodes.summary: Free live workshop with voice profile and Speak Human; 90min live build-along, Joe-rated YES 2026-09-16, automation 4, NEXT status

nodes.name: ManyChat Automation
nodes.summary: Facebook Messenger automation platform for giveaway comment triggers and delivery DMs; uses flows activated by keywords

nodes.name: HookLab
nodes.summary: Hook generation tool with CTA First mode for giveaway marketing; generates 15 scored candidates across 5 mechanisms

nodes.name: Resend Email Service
nodes.summary: Email delivery service for giveaway welcome and follow-up emails; rejects emails with CR/LF in headers
